CREATE TABLE "public"."AnalyticsEvent" (
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "durationSeconds" int4,
  "eventType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nuggetId" text,
  "platform" text DEFAULT 'web' NOT NULL,
  "visitorId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AppSettings" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dailyPublishTime" text DEFAULT '06:00' NOT NULL,
  "defaultLanguage" text DEFAULT 'English' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ipAllowListEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "maintenanceMode" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sessionTimeoutMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "siteName" text DEFAULT 'Business Nuggets' NOT NULL,
  "supportEmail" text DEFAULT 'support@businessnuggets.com' NOT NULL,
  "tagline" text DEFAULT 'Command Your Business with Absolute Clarity' NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text DEFAULT 'WAT (UTC+1)' NOT NULL,
  "twoFactorAdmins" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "adminEmail" text,
  "adminId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "path" text NOT NULL,
  "result" text DEFAULT 'success' NOT NULL,
  "target" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BillingTransaction" (
  "amountCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "planSlug" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text,
  "providerReference" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Comment" (
  "adminReply" text,
  "authorName" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nuggetId" text NOT NULL,
  "reportCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MediaAsset" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "filename" text NOT NULL,
  "folderId" int4,
  "height" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "originalName" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  "width" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MediaFolder" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MobileAppSettings" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dailyNuggetWidget" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "forceUpdate" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "homeBannerTitle" text DEFAULT 'Command Your Business with Absolute Clarity' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "maintenanceMode" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "offlineReading" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MobileAppVersion" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "installCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "platform" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'review' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MobileOnboardingScreen" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "step" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."NotificationCampaign" (
  "audience" text DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL,
  "channel" text DEFAULT 'push' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "platform" text DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL,
  "reach" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sendAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."NuggetSchedule" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nuggetId" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduledFor" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SavedFolder" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SavedFolderItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "folderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nuggetId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ScriptureBook" (
  "chapterCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "visible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SubscriptionPlan" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "billingCycle" text DEFAULT 'free' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'USD' NOT NULL,
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "features" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priceCents" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "SubscriptionPlan_features_elem_not_null_1a661718" CHECK (array_position("features", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Topic" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "displayOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "visible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
